description: Use when the user asks about a domain's DMARC record itself, or why reports do not arrive. Returns policy, subdomain policy, pct, alignment and report addresses with findings. For a spoofing verdict use spoofable. Ex: 'What is the DMARC policy of example.com?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.
